changed: kept numeric-magnitude regex features unchanged (verified real signal, low overfitting risk)
reverted TF-IDF vocabulary and TruncatedSVD components to exp-001's conservative sizes (6000/6000 word+char, 60/60 SVD, down from exp-002's 20000/20000 and 120/120)
reverted LightGBM capacity down (num_leaves=31, n_estimators=500, down from num_leaves=63, n_estimators=2500)
added explicit regularization: reg_alpha=1.0, reg_lambda=1.0, min_child_samples=30, feature_fraction=0.8, bagging_fraction=0.8 (all disabled in exp-002)
kept log1p target training (unlikely overfitting cause, empirically helpful)

delta_vs_parent.note: cv_primary is WORSE than exp-002's 363,814.43 by design -- exp-002's better CV came with a worse real Kaggle score (468,497.07 vs exp-001's ~460,000), so this experiment deliberately trades CV for reduced overfitting risk.
